$comment: Daňové priznanie k DPH (§ 78 zákona o DPH), form DPHv25 for periods starting on 2025-07-01 or later: XML layout of the official XSD (form 616) and the map from the amounts of the VAT records to its rows. rowOrder is the full sequence of the body as the XSD expects it (splneniePodmienok is an element between r32 and r33). Row meanings after the poučenie k DPHv25: 01/01a/03 supplies at 19 %, 5 %, 23 % (02/02a/04 tax); 05/05a/07 acquisitions from the EU (06/06a/08 tax); 09/09a/09b supplies where the recipient pays the tax under § 69 ods. 2, 3, 9 to 12 (10/10a/10b tax); 11/11a/11b triangular trade of the second buyer (12/12a/12b tax); 11c/11d/11e self-assessed import (12c/12d/12e tax); 13 all exempt supplies; 14 of which § 43 ods. 1 and 4; 15 supplies under § 69 ods. 12 by the supplier; 17 tax in total; 18/18a/19 deduction at 19 %, 5 %, 23 %; 31 own liability; 32 excess deduction; 35 own liability to pay. The rows the app does not compute (triangular trade, import, coefficient, corrections, carried excess) stay empty. verified stays false until an accountant confirms the map against the poučenie.
